# buzz-project-init

Initialize a new project — creates a GitHub repo with a README, clones it locally, and announces it on Buzz with a project wrapper. Use when the user says "create new project", "init project", or "new repo".

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$buzz-project-init`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
